name: StandIn
tagline: Agents that stand in for each person at work, swap scoped updates and handle low-stakes coordination.

awards: MLH: Best Use of Auth0 AI Agents

problem: Meetings and follow-ups consume time and attention even for interns, the team says.
solution: An orchestrator agent classifies intent and routes to status, history or action agents over calendar, Jira and Slack; a local trust layer redacts sensitive content before anything leaves.
demo_moment: Team-described: two agents negotiate a meeting slot and add it to both calendars.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Auth0 AI Agents” among 307 submissions.
Raw workplace data stays behind a local redaction layer.

lessons: Agents that talk to each other need a boundary for what leaves each person.
